text: Call hosted language models through Model APIs without deploying your own instance
quote: Use Model APIs to call supported language models without deploying them.

text: Deploy open-source, fine-tuned, or custom models on dedicated GPU infrastructure
quote: Deploy an open-source, fine-tuned, or custom model on dedicated GPUs.

text: Fine-tune models with Loops or run your own training code, then deploy the resulting checkpoint as a production endpoint on the same platform
quote: Your Axolotl config, TRL script, or custom loop runs unchanged in a container. Baseten provisions the GPUs, syncs checkpoints as your job saves them, and deploys any checkpoint as a production endpoint.

text: Documentation shows how to point coding agents at Model APIs
quote: To point a coding agent at Model APIs, see [Coding agents](/inference/model-apis/coding-agents).

text: Official Baseten MCP server lets a coding agent manage the workspace and search docs
quote: Install the Baseten skill and MCP servers so your coding agent can manage your Baseten workspace and search these docs.

text: Structured outputs enforce responses against a JSON schema for reliable data extraction
quote: Structured outputs let you generate text that conforms to specific JSON schemas, providing reliable data extraction and controlled text generation.

text: Function/tool calling lets a model choose a tool and generate its arguments from a request
quote: Function calling* (also called *tool calling*) lets a model choose a tool and produce its arguments from a user request.

text: Streaming returns tokens over server-sent events as they are generated
quote: Streaming sends tokens as they are generated over server-sent events, which suits long generations and UIs where partial output beats a blank wait.

text: Async inference returns a request ID immediately and completes later via webhook or polling
quote: Async inference returns a request ID quickly and completes later through webhook or polling, which suits batch work, long documents, or any case where the caller should not hold a connection open for minutes.

text: Model APIs bill per token
quote: Model APIs bill by token and enforce request and token rate limits. You can also set a workspace budget and query usage by API key or model.

text: Rate limit headers report remaining request/token allowance
quote: x-ratelimit-remaining-requests: Reports how many requests remain before you reach the request rate limit.

text: Basic account rate limits can be raised via email verification, or by upgrading to Pro/Enterprise tiers
quote: To raise a Basic account's limits, request email verification. You can also use that form to move to Pro or Enterprise.

text: Set a workspace budget to cap spend on Model APIs
quote: You can also set a workspace budget and query usage by API key or model.

text: Query token/request usage broken down by API key or model
quote: To monitor token and request consumption by API key or model, see Usage.

text: Prompt tokens served from KV cache are automatically cached at a discounted rate
quote: Cached input tokens are prompt tokens served from the KV cache at a discounted rate. Caching is automatic and requires no request flags.

text: Truss packages model code, weights, and dependencies into a server that behaves identically in dev and production
quote: Write once, run anywhere: Package model code, weights, and dependencies with a model server that behaves the same in development and production.

text: A config.yaml defines the model, hardware, and inference engine without writing custom serving code
quote: a `config.yaml` can define the model, hardware, and inference engine without custom serving code

text: The truss push CLI command builds an optimized container and deploys it with no Dockerfile or container management needed
quote: You write a `config.yaml` that specifies the model, the hardware, and the engine, then `uvx truss push` builds a TensorRT-optimized container and deploys it. No Python code, no Dockerfile, no container management.

text: Deprecated model weights can be migrated to a dedicated deployment with vendor assistance
quote: Migrate to a dedicated deployment with the deprecated model weights. Contact us for assistance.

text: Deployments run active-active across clusters and clouds, with automatic rerouting/reprovisioning on capacity loss
quote: Deployments run active-active across clusters and clouds. If a region or provider loses capacity, MCM reroutes and reprovisions workloads.

text: Baseten Switch can route to Pi's direct provider, compare spend against Anthropic/OpenAI, and route requests back to those providers
quote: Switch can also install Pi's direct Baseten provider, compare Baseten spend with estimated costs from Anthropic or OpenAI, and route requests back to those providers.

text: A custom Python model class or Docker server can be used for custom pre/postprocessing and server behavior
quote: Use a Python model class or a custom Docker server when you need custom preprocessing, postprocessing, dependencies, or server behavior.

text: Supports the OpenAI Chat Completions API and Anthropic Messages API (beta) so existing client SDKs work unmodified
quote: They support the OpenAI Chat Completions API and the Anthropic Messages API in beta, so you can use familiar client SDKs.

text: Connect Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Pi to Baseten via the Baseten Switch tool
quote: Connect Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Pi with Baseten Switch.

text: Deploy any synced training checkpoint to production with a single CLI command
quote: Deploy any synced checkpoint with one CLI command

text: Truss supports models built with transformers, diffusers, PyTorch, TensorFlow, vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM
quote: Truss lets you serve models with the Baseten Inference Stack as well as deploy models from any open-source framework: vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, `transformers`, `diffusers`, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and more.

text: LangChain's ChatOpenAI with structured output works against Baseten by pointing base_url at it
quote: Because Baseten exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, you can use LangChain's `ChatOpenAI` with `with_structured_output` by pointing `base_url` at Baseten

text: Stable environments are supported for development, staging, and production deployments
quote: They also support stable environments for development, staging, and production.

text: Fast local developer loop with live reload skips Docker/Kubernetes configuration
quote: Fast developer loop: Iterate with live reload, skip Docker and Kubernetes configuration, and use a batteries-included serving environment.
